projects.title: Sherlock
projects.description: High-throughput job data aggregation platform ingesting 15K+ records/day from 160+ independent sources using 20+ concurrent workers. Engineered content-hash deduplication eliminating 35% overlapping postings and built a relevance-ranking pipeline returning results in under 200ms. Built fault-tolerant ingestion with Redis-backed caching, per-source rate limiting, and exponential-backoff retries reducing redundant requests by 60% with 99% pipeline uptime.

projects.title: EARTHIFY
projects.description: Real-time waste classification service serving a 6-class vision model at 90% accuracy through a Flask API for webcam inference. Optimized inference pipeline with ONNX Runtime, reducing latency from 110ms to 33ms (70% improvement) and reaching 30 FPS on commodity CPU hardware.

projects.title: Project Steve
projects.description: Backend workflow automation platform that compiles natural-language requirements into executable automation workflows. Generates runnable pipelines across 30+ node types with 85% validity on first execution. Designed modular pipeline for requirement parsing, validation, and workflow assembly exposed through 15+ REST endpoints with structured error handling and graceful degradation.
